## Summary

Describe the behavior and boundary being changed.

## Evidence

- [ ] Regression test fails without this change
- [ ] Runtime-control changes include primary evidence and exact platform/runtime scope
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes
- [ ] User-visible behavior is documented in `CHANGELOG.md`

## Security boundary

Explain whether this changes inherited values, overlays, secret delegation, runtime controls, receipts, or resource limits.
